about: Pending US public-company acquisitions. Terms come only from SEC filings and the companies' press releases. verified is true only where the value was read in the raw text of the linked source; anything read only through a summary, or taken from price data, is marked Unverified with a note. Pending means no completion (Item 2.01) or termination (Item 1.02) 8-K was found on EDGAR as of as_of. Not investment advice.
close_date_rule: When a source states a period instead of a date, by_date is the last day of that period (for example first half of 2027 is 2027-06-30).
unaffected_rule: Target close on the last trading day before the announcement, or on the announcement day itself when the deal was announced after that day's close (announced_after_close). When the release names an earlier unaffected date (a leak), that date is used.
